paper_title: A Universal Bound on QCD Axions from Supernovae
notes: Model-independent SN 1987A cooling bound on the axion decay constant from the tree-level c5-hat (isospin-breaking, EDM-inducing) production channel. Headline result Eq. (14): f_a > 1.1(+0.4/-0.6)x10^8 GeV at 68% C.L. (central value corresponds to 1/f_a < 9.1e-9 GeV^-1). The curve reported here is the red 'This work' exclusion region plotted in Fig. 5 (m_a vs 1/f_a plane): its lower edge, measured from the embedded vector figure Axion_fa_new.pdf with axis-frame calibration, is a flat line at 1/f_a = 2.1e-8 GeV^-1 (f_a ~ 5e7 GeV), i.e. the conservative lower edge of the quoted 68% band, spanning the full plotted mass range 1e-20 to 10 eV (bound is independent of m_a over this range). If the compilation instead uses the central quoted value, the flat level would be 9.1e-9 GeV^-1 (factor ~2.3 lower). QCD-axion mass convention in the paper matches m_a = 5.7 ueV x (1e12 GeV/f_a). No dark-matter density assumption (astrophysical SN bound).
